name: ohde se madh-e-naz ke bahar na aa saka

content.roman:
aaj ik aur baras biit gayā us ke baġhair
jis ke hote hue hote the zamāne mere
'ohde se mad.h-e-nāz ke bāhar na aa sakā
gar ik adā ho to use apnī qazā kahūñ
halqe haiñ chashm-hā-e-kushāda ba-sū-e-dil
har tār-e-zulf ko nigah-e-surma-sā kahūñ
maiñ aur sad-hazār navā-e-jigar-ḳharāsh
tū aur ek vo na-shunīdan ki kyā kahūñ
zālim mire gumāñ se mujhe munfa'il na chaah
hai hai ḳhudā-na-karda tujhe bevafā kahūñ
aañsū kahūñ ki aah savār-e-havā kahūñ
aisā 'ināñ-gusīḳhta aayā ki kyā kahūñ
iqbāl-e-kulfat-e-dil-e-be-mudda'ā rassā
aḳhtar ko dāġh-e-sāya-e-bāl-e-humā kahūñ
mazmūn-e-vasl haath na aayā magar use
ab tā.ir-e-par-burīda-e-rang-e-hinā kahūñ
duzdīdan-e-dil-e-sitam-āmāda hai muhāl
mizhgāñ kahūñ ki jauhar-e-teġh-e-qazā kahūñ
tarz-āfrīn-e-nukta-sarā.ī-e-tab' hai
ā.īna-e-ḳhayāl ko tūtī-numā kahūñ
'ġhālib' hai rutba-faham-e-tasavvur se kuchh pare
hai ijz-e-bandagī ki 'alī ko ḳhudā kahūñ
'ohde se madh-e-naz ke bahar na aa saka
gar ek ada ho to use apni qaza kahun
halqe hain chashm-ha-e-kushada ba-su-e-dil
har tar-e-zulf ko nigah-e-surma-sa kahun
main aur sad-hazar nawa-e-jigar-KHarash
tu aur ek wo na-shunidan ki kya kahun
zalim mere guman se mujhe munfa'il na chah
hai hai KHuda-na-karda tujhe bewafa kahun
aansu kahun ki aah sawar-e-hawa kahun
aisa 'inan-gusiKHta aaya ki kya kahun
iqbaal-e-kulfat-e-dil-e-be-mudda'a rassa
aKHtar ko dagh-e-saya-e-baal-e-huma kahun
mazmun-e-wasl hath na aaya magar use
ab tair-e-par-burida-e-rang-e-hina kahun
duzdidan-e-dil-e-sitam-amada hai muhaal
mizhgan kahun ki jauhar-e-tegh-e-qaza kahun
tarz-afrin-e-nukta-sarai-e-tab' hai
aaina-e-KHayal ko tuti-numa kahun
'ghaalib' hai rutba-faham-e-tasawwur se kuchh pare
hai ijz-e-bandagi ki 'ali ko KHuda kahun
